# Legacy Raft fixture

`raft-v3.5.13.json` was generated by LSMEngine commit `cf2eb2f` using
`go.etcd.io/etcd/raft/v3 v3.5.13`, not by the replacement library.

The generator opened the built-in single-node provider as `node-a`, then committed:

1. Put `retained=legacy-value`.
2. Put `deleted=remove-me`.
3. Delete `deleted`.

The file is the resulting `<data>/raft/commitlog-e6971cc22078cb53.json`.
Request IDs are opaque randomly generated proposal identities, not secrets.
The compatibility test verifies committed entries, positions, deterministic data
sequences, a new commit, and a second reopen using the updated adapter.
